_note: The tech tree (docs/V3_DESIGN.md section 5). cost in research points (RP). requires: techs that must be done first. unlocks: buildings, crops, recipes, sizes, levels. bonus: colony-wide values added up over done techs (solar_mult 0.2 = +20%). packs: research packs a lab uses while it works on the tech, spread evenly over the RP (a tech with packs makes no progress without them). boost: packs a tier-1 tech may use for the x2 boost (without them it runs at the base rate). family: tier-5 tech that unlocks Level 5 for that building family. branch/tier place the node in the tree screen.

eng_1.name: Structural Engineering
eng_1.desc: Size L for every structure. Upgrades to level 2.

life_1.name: Water Reclamation
life_1.desc: The water recycler returns used water to the network.

agri_1.name: Crop Genetics
agri_1.desc: Tomatoes, soybeans and herbs. New dishes become possible.

ind_1.name: Silicate Processing
ind_1.desc: Harvest silicate sand and melt it into glass.

sci_1.name: Field Science
sci_1.desc: Research labs make 25% more research points.

sci_packs_1.name: Research Packs
sci_packs_1.desc: The research assembler makes basic research packs from water and power. Tier 2 research needs them.

eng_2.name: Advanced Construction
eng_2.desc: Size XL for every structure. Upgrades to level 3.

life_2.name: Atmospheric Processing
life_2.desc: Makes oxygen from the thin air outside, with power and no water.

agri_2.name: Fungiculture
agri_2.desc: Mushrooms grow in the dark with little power and water.

ind_2.name: Microelectronics
ind_2.desc: Circuit boards from silicate and steel.

energy_2.name: Grid Storage
energy_2.desc: Batteries hold 30% more. Wind turbines make 20% more.

comfort_1.name: Recreation Science
comfort_1.desc: The cantina: more recreation places and better morale.

log_1.name: Cold Chain
log_1.desc: Cold storage stops food from spoiling.

sci_packs_2.name: Applied Packs
sci_packs_2.desc: Applied research packs from glass, electronics and water. Tier 3 and 4 research needs them.

sci_auto.name: Lab Automation
sci_auto.desc: A research lab with no scientist works at 30% by itself.

suit_1.name: Extended Suits
suit_1.desc: Suits hold 50% more air. Colonists work further from an airlock.

haz_anchor.name: Storm Anchoring
haz_anchor.desc: Wind storms do 60% less damage to exterior structures. Wind turbines feather their blades.

haz_predict.name: Predictive Maintenance
haz_predict.desc: Machines wear 20% slower. Breakdowns are forecast 50% earlier.

haz_seismograph.name: Seismograph
haz_seismograph.desc: Quakes are forecast 90 seconds before they start, not 20.

agri_3.name: Algae Culture
agri_3.desc: Bioreactors grow protein-rich algae and add oxygen.

sci_2.name: Deep Survey
sci_2.desc: Find exotic crystals deep under mineral deposits.

space_1.name: Propellant Chemistry
space_1.desc: Rocket fuel from water and power.

sci_net.name: Data Network
sci_net.desc: Each extra research lab joined by corridors adds 10% to every lab, up to 30%.

suit_2.name: Deep-range Suits
suit_2.desc: Suits hold 120% more air than the first suits.

haz_turret_1.name: Meteor Defense I
haz_turret_1.desc: The meteor defense turret shoots down meteors within 70 m while it has charge.

haz_surge.name: Surge Protection
haz_surge.desc: Solar flares no longer trip electronics, labs, comms towers and turrets.

haz_rad.name: Radiation Shielding
haz_rad.desc: Solar flares do 60% less harm to colonists outside.

energy_3.name: Fusion Ignition
energy_3.desc: A fusion reactor: 60 P day and night.

space_2.name: Orbital Logistics
space_2.desc: The comms tower. The Meridian can fly supply runs.

haz_turret_2.name: Meteor Defense II
haz_turret_2.desc: Turrets cover 100 m and charge 50% faster.

sci_packs_3.name: Exotic Packs
sci_packs_3.desc: Exotic research packs from exotic crystal, composite and electronics. Special research needs them.

s_agri.name: Quantum Hydroponics
s_agri.desc: SPECIAL. Level 5 for greenhouses, fungus farms, bioreactors and kitchens.

s_life.name: Terraforming Catalysts
s_life.desc: SPECIAL. Level 5 for oxygen, water and atmosphere structures.

s_ind.name: Nanofabrication
s_ind.desc: SPECIAL. Level 5 for every industry structure.

s_energy.name: Stellarator Containment
s_energy.desc: SPECIAL. Level 5 for solar, wind, batteries and fusion.

s_hab.name: Arcology Design
s_hab.desc: SPECIAL. Level 5 for habitats, lounges, cantinas, medical, storage, research labs and assemblers.

ind_carbon.name: Carbon Chemistry
ind_carbon.desc: Mine carbon ore at crevice edges. The carbon works makes graphite and carbon fibre.

ind_ceramic.name: Technical Ceramics
ind_ceramic.desc: The ceramics kiln fires silicate and slag into ceramic.

ind_salvage.name: Salvage Engineering
ind_salvage.desc: A workshop takes spare parts and electronics from derelict parts.

ind_ti.name: Titanium Metallurgy
ind_ti.desc: Mine titanium ore on plateaus. The titanium smelter makes titanium.

ind_alloy.name: Alloy Steel
ind_alloy.desc: The steel mill makes alloy steel from iron ore and carbon ore.

ind_chem.name: Process Chemistry
ind_chem.desc: The chemical plant makes acid and coolant from slag, ice and polymer.

ind_composite2.name: Carbon Composites
ind_composite2.desc: The fabricator makes two composite panels from carbon fibre and polymer.

ind_hull2.name: Titanium Hull
ind_hull2.desc: A level 2 fabricator makes three hull plates from titanium and composite.

energy_batt.name: Battery Chemistry
energy_batt.desc: The battery plant makes battery cells.

nuc_1.name: Nuclear Prospecting
nuc_1.desc: Mine uranium and thorium ore in radiation fields. Wear shielded suits: the dose counts (milestone 6).

nuc_rods.name: Fuel Rod Fabrication
nuc_rods.desc: The chemical plant leaches yellowcake; the fuel rod plant makes fuel rods.

nuc_thorium.name: Thorium Cycle
nuc_thorium.desc: Fuel rods from thorium ore, ceramic and acid.

nuc_reactor.name: Fission Power
nuc_reactor.desc: The fission reactor: huge power day and night. It needs fuel rods, coolant and care.

nuc_safety.name: Reactor Safety
nuc_safety.desc: Faster SCRAM and a longer warning before a meltdown (milestone 6).

fusion_he3.name: Helium-3 Fuel
fusion_he3.desc: Seal helium-3 gas with titanium into fusion fuel.

veh_parts.name: Rover Parts
veh_parts.desc: The parts works makes rover parts, and spare parts from alloy steel.

veh_hopper2.name: Hopper Engines
veh_hopper2.desc: A hopper uses 30 % less fuel for each hop.

logi_routes.name: Route Planning
logi_routes.desc: Vehicles can run routes between bases (vehicle_route).

exp_survey.name: Survey Methods
exp_survey.desc: Colonists and vehicles see 25 % further into unexplored land. A research assembler makes advanced packs from blueprint fragments.

exp_sat.name: Orbital Survey
exp_sat.desc: Build and launch a survey satellite from a launch pad. It maps the planet while an uplink (a comms tower) has power.

exp_deep_scan.name: Deep Scan
exp_deep_scan.desc: The satellite also surveys the deposits in the bands it maps.

rad_3.name: Radiation Medicine
rad_3.desc: The medical bay treats radiation sickness (milestone 6).

sci_packs_4.name: Advanced Research Packs
sci_packs_4.desc: The research assembler makes advanced packs from alloy steel, ceramic and battery cells.

mine_deep.name: Deep Crater Mining
mine_deep.desc: Mine the dark crater floors (deep ice, helium-3) and the exotic crystal on the peaks.

mine_rare.name: Crevice Mining
mine_rare.desc: Mine rare-earth ore on crevice floors; the chemical plant refines it.

deep_he3.name: Helium-3 Separation
deep_he3.desc: The helium-3 separator takes helium-3 gas from crater dust.

deep_super.name: Superconductors
deep_super.desc: The superconductor lab (level 2) draws superconductor wire.

deep_packs.name: Deep Research Packs
deep_packs.desc: The research assembler makes deep packs (and three from a data core).

deep_crystal.name: Crystal Lattices
deep_crystal.desc: Purify exotic crystal and grow crystal lattices. The refinery is unstable.

deep_electronics.name: Graphene Electronics
deep_electronics.desc: A level 2 electronics fab makes four electronics from graphene and silicate.

civic_1.name: Civic Planning
civic_1.desc: Parks, the security office, the jail and executive homes in the residence tube.

civic_2.name: High-rise Housing
civic_2.desc: The three-storey apartment block with penthouses.

education.name: Education
education.desc: Courses at the academy run 25 % faster.

security.name: Security Training
security.desc: Security officers respond 25 % faster and calm fights sooner.

arcology.name: Arcology
arcology.desc: The Super Dome: a city block under glass. Needs graphene and metamaterials.
